content: Kshana tat kramayoh samyamad vivekajam jnanam. (By practicing Samyama on the single present moment and its succession, intuitive wisdom is born).
author: Patanjali
explanation:
In the profound psychology of the Yoga Sutras, Patanjali outlines the systematic roadmap for stilling mental fluctuations into radiant, sovereign stillness.

This teaching (Kshana tat kramayoh samyamad vivekajam jnanam. (By practicin...) focuses directly on kshana and kramayoh. When we clear away reactive illusions and anchor ourselves in timeless principles, the mind recovers its pristine clarity and inner resilience.

True realization is never an abstract intellectual debate—it is an active discipline lived through quiet integrity and conscious presence in everyday moments.
practicalInsight: Apply this teaching on kshana today: take a deliberate pause before reacting, align your actions with quiet integrity, and refuse to let transient friction disturb your center.
reflectionPrompt: How can you embody deeper kshana and kramayoh in the primary challenge you are navigating right now?
